﻿Description

Unlock the full potential of image manipulation with theFlux.2 Klein 9B: Single Image Editingworkflow. This setup is precision-engineered for creators who need to modify, enhance, or completely transform existing images while maintaining incredible structural integrity.

By utilizing theKlein 9Barchitecture, this workflow offers superior semantic understanding, allowing you to make complex edits through simple prompt adjustments and optimized Image-to-Image (i2i) pipelines.

Key Features

  • Precision Editing:Targeted modifications—change outfits, lighting, or background elements without losing the essence of your original subject.

  • 9B Model Power:Leverages the enhanced parameter count of the Klein 9B model for better prompt adherence and realistic textures.

  • High Fidelity:Optimized to preserve the fine details of your source image while injecting the artistic flair of Flux.2.

  • Streamlined UI:A clean and logical node layout designed for both speed and ease of use.

Technical Recommendations

  • Base Model:Flux.2 Klein 9B

  • Workflow Type:Image-to-Image / Editing

  • Denoising Strength:1

  • Steps:8

  • Sampler:sampler,, Euler]

Getting Started

  1. Upload Source:Drag and drop your image into the "Input Image" node.

  2. Set Prompt:Describe the changes you want to see (e.g., "Change the jacket to red leather").

  3. Adjust Denoise:Tune the denoise slider based on how much of the original image you want to keep.
